bootstrapScriptUrl.description: pre-authenticated URL of the bootstrap script in Object Store that can be downloaded and executed.

clusterProfile.description: Profile of the Big Data Service cluster.

createdBy.description: The user who created the cluster.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer and boolean types are supported.

Key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
For example, `{"bar-key": "value"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
For example, `{"foo-namespace": {"bar-key": "value"}}`

freeformTags.description:
Simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type, or scope.
Exists for cross-compatibility only. For example, `{"bar-key": "value"}`

id.description: The OCID of the Big Data Service resource.

isCloudSqlConfigured.description: Boolean flag specifying whether or not Cloud SQL should be configured.

isHighAvailability.description: Boolean flag specifying whether or not the cluster is highly available (HA)

isKafkaConfigured.description: Boolean flag specifying whether or not Kafka should be configured.

isSecretReused.description: Boolean flag specifying whether or not to persist the provided secret OCID and reuse it for future operations.

isSecure.description: Boolean flag specifying whether or not the cluster should be set up as secure.

kmsKeyId.description: The OCID of the Key Management master encryption key.

nodes.description: The list of nodes in the cluster.

numberOfNodes.description: Number of nodes that forming the cluster

numberOfNodesRequiringMaintenanceReboot.description: Number of nodes that require a maintenance reboot

timeCreated.description: The time the cluster was created, shown as an RFC 3339 formatted datetime string.

timeEarliestCertificateExpiration.description: The earliest time of certificate expiration date across the certificates of all current nodes under this cluster.

timeUpdated.description: The time the cluster was updated, shown as an RFC 3339 formatted datetime string.

BdsClusterVersionSummary.description: Cluster version details including bds and odh version information.

bdsVersion.description: BDS version to be used for cluster creation

odhVersion.description: ODH version to be used for cluster creation

CloudSqlDetails.description: The information about added Cloud SQL capability

blockVolumeSizeInGBs.description:
The size of block volume in GB that needs to be attached to a given node.
All the necessary details needed for attachment are managed by service itself.

ipAddress.description: IP address of the Cloud SQL node.

isKerberosMappedToDatabaseUsers.description:
Boolean flag specifying whether or not Kerberos principals are mapped
to database users.

ClusterDetails.description: Specific info about a Hadoop cluster

bdaVersion.description: BDA version installed in the cluster

bdmVersion.description: Big Data Manager version installed in the cluster.

bdsVersion.description: Big Data Service version installed in the cluster.

bigDataManagerUrl.description: The URL of Big Data Manager.

dbVersion.description: Cloud SQL query server database version.

hueServerUrl.description: The URL of the Hue server.

odhVersion.description: Version of the ODH (Oracle Distribution including Apache Hadoop) installed on the cluster.

osVersion.description: Oracle Linux version installed in the cluster.

timeCreated.description: The time the cluster was created, shown as an RFC 3339 formatted datetime string.

timeRefreshed.description: The time the cluster was automatically or manually refreshed, shown as an RFC 3339 formatted datetime string.

NetworkConfig.description: Additional configuration of the user's network.

cidrBlock.description: The CIDR IP address block of the VCN.

isNatGatewayRequired.description: A boolean flag whether to configure a NAT gateway.

attachedBlockVolumes.description: The list of block volumes attached to a given node.

availabilityDomain.description: The name of the availability domain in which the node is running.

certificateConfigurationId.description: ID of the certificate configuration which is used to generate the certificate for the node.

faultDomain.description: The name of the fault domain in which the node is running.

hostname.description: The fully-qualified hostname (FQDN) of the node.

imageId.description: The OCID of the image from which the node was created.

instanceId.description: The OCID of the underlying Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Compute instance.

isRebootRequired.description: Indicates if the node requires a reboot to either reflect the latest os kernel or take actions for maintenance reboot.

localDisksTotalSizeInGBs.description: The aggregate size of all local disks, in gigabytes. If the instance does not have any local disks, this field is null.

memoryInGBs.description: The total amount of memory available to the node, in gigabytes.

nodeBackupId.description: The node back id that was used for replacing the node.

nvmes.description: The number of NVMe drives to be used for storage. A single drive has 6.8 TB available.

ocpus.description: The total number of OCPUs available to the node.

odhVersion.description: Version of the ODH (Oracle Distribution including Apache Hadoop) for the node.

osVersion.description: BDS-assigned Operating System version for the node.

sshFingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the SSH key used for node access.

subnetId.description: The OCID of the subnet in which the node is to be created.

timeCreated.description: The time the node was created, shown as an RFC 3339 formatted datetime string.

timeMaintenanceRebootDue.description: The date and time the instance is expected to be stopped / started, in the format defined by RFC3339.

timeReplaced.description: The date and time the instance was replaced by a new vm with a node backup.

timeUpdated.description: The time the cluster was updated, shown as an RFC 3339 formatted datetime string.

VolumeAttachmentDetail.description: A detail of the attached block volume.

volumeAttachmentId.description: The OCID of the volume attachment.

volumeSizeInGBs.description: The size of the volume in GBs.
